name: Blueprint accepted-item revision pin mutation probe
command: npx vitest run packages/operator-core/lib/work-items-lifecycle.integration.test.ts -t "blueprint direct-item revision pin" --reporter=dot
summary: With a held mutation-probe file lock, the baseline A-to-B canonical work-item test passed. A mutant that rereads the mutable current blueprint hash instead of the accepted revision made that test fail after B projection. The runner reported MUTANT CAUGHT and restored the source byte-for-byte.

assertions.evidence: Baseline focused Vitest: 1 passed, 45 filtered, exit 0.

Mutation changed only readAcceptedBlueprintDirectWorkItem's snapshot lookup from pin.specificationRevision to readBlueprintHashFromPg(current). After revision B projection, focused Vitest failed at line 272 with 'accepted blueprint operation pin does not match the work item'; mutant guard exited 1.
mutation-probe.sh reported target=in-tree:lock-held, verdict=caught, baseline_exit=0, guard_exit=1, and tree integrity VERIFIED: operation-admission.ts byte-identical to its pre-probe state.
